speaker: walt
text: Well, hello there! A real ice cream parlor. Stools and everything. I'm home.

speaker: walt
text: I proposed at a soda fountain in '55. Down on one knee. These days I'd need a crew to get back up.

speaker: walt
text: Swell! Just swell. That's the way they made it. Exactly the way.

speaker: walt
text: In '55, if you asked for something, you got it. And a smile.
